verdict.rationale: Statsig is a feature-flag, experimentation and analytics platform, not an AI agent or LLM host, so consuming third-party MCP servers' tools does not fit this kind of product. The evidence shows Statsig only in the MCP server role: its own MCP server and Docs MCP server serve Statsig data to clients like Cursor, Claude Code and ChatGPT. That is a different role and does not make the client axis apply. Nothing shows Statsig itself connecting to external MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
